---
title: "Render the slug field's custom components"
description: "Drop when the pinned release's SlugField renders customComponents."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.3. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

A slug field ignores every custom component it declares. SlugField's admin
config takes components.Label, Error, Description, beforeInput and
afterInput, and the server renders them into the field's form state, but
the client component never reads customComponents and always renders the
default label, error and description. A function admin.description is lost
too, because Payload passes it to the client as a rendered Description
component. A site can't show, for example, the page's address under its
slug, short of replacing the whole field with admin.components.Field.

SlugField now reads customComponents from useField, as the text field does,
renders Label, Error and Description through RenderCustomComponent with the
defaults as fallbacks, and renders beforeInput and afterInput around the
input.

- **Patch:** `slug-field-custom-components`, committed as `fix(ui): render the slug field's custom components`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `e2e suite (admin.spec.ts custom admin components test)`
